description: This file defines the 'Ip' class in the Opencart admin module, related to fraud management. It manages the storage and retrieval of IP addresses identified as malicious or suspicious, including installation/uninstallation of the relevant database table, and methods to add, remove, and query IPs.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Model class for managing IP addresses related to fraud detection within the Opencart admin extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'fraud_ip' table in the database to store IP addresses with their date added.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'fraud_ip' table from the database.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the 'fraud_ip' table.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes a specified IP address from the 'fraud_ip' table.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IP addresses from the table, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the total number of IPs stored in the table.

methods.name: getTotalIpsByIp
methods.description: Returns the count of a specific IP address in the table.
